candidates.claim: Custom fields stay open after firstLoad moves the range to the saved Default, so the panel shows a default range with the Custom date fields visible and the Custom radio unchecked.
candidates.trigger: 1. Host settings read is slow (no reply within the 1.5 s fallback), so firstLoad waits on pendingDefaultRead. 2. Person clicks the Custom radio: ranges click handler (src/panel/panel.js:834-840) unhides #custom-range and returns without setting state.rangePicked. 3. Read answers '30d'. firstLoad (src/panel/panel.js:605-610) sees !rangePicked and range !== '30d', sets state.range = '30d', re-checks the radio buttons so Custom is aria-checked=false, and sets moved. 4. Nothing hides #custom-range (only clearFilter at :159 and the non-custom ranges click at :842 do). 5. Result: Custom date fields visible, report shows 30d, no radio marked custom. Dates are not applied until Apply, so the displayed report is still consistent with state.range.
candidates.wrong: Shows: open custom date form next to a 30d report with no custom radio checked. Should: either keep the form hidden when the default is applied, or treat the Custom click as a pick (set rangePicked) so the default does not move under it.
candidates.path: src/panel/panel.js:834 (Custom click, no rangePicked) -> src/panel/panel.js:605-610 (firstLoad moves range, no custom-range reset) -> panel/index.html same logic (built, verified identical)
candidates.confidence: medium; needs a read that outlives the user's Custom click (slow host). Settle by a test: click custom before the setting answers, then answer 30d, assert custom-range hidden or rangePicked set.
candidates.class: UI control opened by user gesture that does not count as a pick, while a deferred async default later overwrites the mode
candidates.sweep: Other writers of state.range: applyDates (:295, sets rangePicked) checked-fine; clearFilter (:158, restores default, hides custom-range) checked-fine; ranges click (:844-846) checked-fine. Other deferred default-applies: slow-timer load (:599) only loads, does not move range, checked-fine. Not checked: whether render() reads the custom fields when state.range is not custom.
